responsibility: This implementation module provides terminal-oriented formatted I/O for unsigned integer types in the Logitech/PIM compatibility library. It reads tokens from InOut, trims leading whitespace with DynamicStrings helpers, converts them through StringConvert routines to CARDINAL, LONGCARD, or SHORTCARD values in base 10 or 16, and emits formatted strings back through InOut while updating the module-level Done flag.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation half of CardinalIO: unlike CardinalIO.def, it performs the actual parsing and formatting via InOut, DynamicStrings, and StringConvert while updating the module-level Done flag.
